news.headline: Trump says US to send one-time $90 payment to 20 million Medicare recipients
news.body: President Donald Trump said the US will send a one-time $90 payment to more than 20 million people enrolled in Medicare to help offset monthly premium costs. The White House said most eligible recipients will receive direct deposits or checks in early October, and the announcement comes ahead of the November 2026 midterm elections.
